info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Axinitec Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of detailed information about Axinitec recliners to the catalog. It enables businesses to enhance their product offerings by accurately capturing specifications, features, and pricing. Typical consumers of this API include catalog managers and e-commerce platforms looking to manage product details efficiently. By using this API, users can ensure that their product information is up-to-date and comprehensive to facilitate better customer decisions.

post.summary: Create or update details for an Axinitec recliner.
